acceptance_criterion: An equipment type records a name, description, technical characteristics, and total quantity held; total quantity must be zero or greater
test_name: P2 AC1 creates bulk and serialized equipment types with every required detail and accepts zero

acceptance_criterion: Units can be marked unavailable for a stated period with a mandatory reason; the end of the period must be later than the start
test_name: P2 AC2 records bulk and serialized unavailability only with a reason and increasing period

acceptance_criterion: Reducing the total quantity below the quantity already reserved for any overlapping period is refused, and the message names the affected event references and reserved quantities; the total quantity is unchanged
test_name: P2 AC3 refuses a reduction below overlapping reservations, names every event and quantity, and changes nothing

acceptance_criterion: Every inventory or unavailability change records the acting user, the timestamp, and the previous and new quantity
test_name: P2 AC4 audits inventory and unavailability with actor, timestamp, and previous/new quantity

acceptance_criterion: Only Technical Support Staff can change inventory; a change attempted by another role stores nothing
test_name: P2 AC5 refuses inventory and unavailability writes by %s and stores nothing

acceptance_criterion: A reduction to one above the overlapping reserved quantity is accepted without changing reservations
test_name: P2-T13 checks below, at and above ten reserved units without altering reservations
